name: Kat's Canvas
summary:
Kat’s Canvas is a mixed reality art studio for artists, makers, and anyone who wants to bring digital reference images into the real world.
What started as a project for his disabled mom became a full creative workspace built around comfort, focus, and precision. Import your own artwork or reference image, place it directly onto a real canvas, wall, or surface, then scale, rotate, fade, calibrate, and lock it into position so you can trace, paint, sketch, or plan your piece with confidence.
